This model is based on glTF smaple asset `TextureEncodingTest`.

Changes from the original:
* Fifth column added 8-bit PNG files with an sRGB chunk.
* Sixth column added 16-bit PNG files with no metadata chunks.
* Seventh column added 16-bit PNG files with custom gAMA and cHRM chunks.
* Eighth column added 16-bit PNG files with custom iCCP chunk.
* Ninth column added 16-bit PNG files with an sRGB chunk.
